name: ELEGOO
summary: Shenzhen electronics and 3D printing company founded 2015 by Chris Hong (with co-founder Kevin Wang); the name combines 'ELE' (electronic) and 'GOO' (googol). Best known for the Mars/Saturn resin printers, with FDM (Neptune, Centauri Carbon) and filament as a newer expansion. Elegoo appears to produce its own-brand filament directly and is the owner-verified manufacturer behind the Deeplee label. Catalog is unusually broad for a printer brand, running from budget PLA to flame-retardant PC and carbon/glass-filled composites.

oem_relationships.notes: Owner-verified per research/verified-oem-relationships.md: Deeplee (deeplee3d.com) filament is manufactured by Elegoo. Deeplee is recorded here rather than as its own entry.

product_lines.name: PLA (RFID) / PLA (RFID) emoji Brand Edition
product_lines.notes: RFID-tagged standard PLA, same resin as PLA Basic

product_lines.name: PLA Pro
product_lines.notes: Second toughened tier marketed above PLA Plus for impact resistance; same PLA+ class chemistry, Elegoo positions the two as distinct grades

product_lines.name: Rapid PLA Plus
product_lines.notes: Toughened PLA on a high-flow/high-speed rheology - fits both the PLA+ and high-flow PLA descriptions

product_lines.name: PLA Copper Filled
product_lines.notes: Copper-powder-filled PLA; heavier-fill member of the metal-filled class

product_lines.name: PLA Marble
product_lines.notes: PLA with mineral marble-effect filler; no dedicated marble id in catalog

product_lines.name: PLA Galaxy / PLA Sparkle
product_lines.notes: PLA with glitter particulate; no dedicated glitter-PLA id in catalog

product_lines.name: Rapid PETG
product_lines.notes: High-flow PETG for fast printing; process delta only

product_lines.name: TPU 95A / Rapid TPU 95A
product_lines.notes: Shore 95A TPU; Rapid variant is a high-flow version of the same durometer

product_lines.name: PC-FR
product_lines.notes: Flame-retardant polycarbonate. Catalog has abs-fr but no flame-retardant PC id - reported as a gap (suggested pc-fr)

product_lines.name: PAHT-CF
product_lines.notes: High-temperature polyamide + carbon fibre; ppa-cf lists PAHT-CF as an alias

additional_notes: Standard PLA roughly $13-19/kg, with engineering and CF lines priced well above; 10kg bulk spools are offered. Sells PEI sheets and spring-steel plates for the Neptune and Centauri Carbon lines. ChiTuBox is a closely associated slicer widely used with Elegoo resin printers, but the relationship is a partnership or possible investment rather than a confirmed subsidiary. In-house software includes ELEGOO Slicer, ELEGOO SatelLite, Nexprint and the ELEGOO Matrix App. No evidence found that Elegoo outsources its own-brand filament to another OEM.

provenance.conflicts: Exact registered legal entity name could not be confirmed beyond the 'ELEGOO' brand (China and US registrations both referenced). Ownership relationship to ChiTuBox is unconfirmed — partner or investor rather than verified subsidiary.
